name: LeadShield Contact Form & B2B Solicitation Blocker
tagline: 2-stage contact form spam and B2B cold-pitch solicitation blocker
description: Block contact form spam, SEO cold pitches, and B2B solicitations across GoHighLevel (GHL), WordPress, HubSpot, and custom websites over Streamable HTTP. Combines $0.00 Stage 0 deterministic bot drops with Stage 1 calibrated buyer-intent classification, server-side per-site country/phone/URL policies, and weekly blocked-spam reports. Exposes 5 tools (`leadshield_screen_submission`, `leadshield_get_blocked_spam_report`, `leadshield_get_spam_policy`, `leadshield_configure_spam_policy`, and `leadshield_generate_guard_embed`). Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

install.notes: Connects over Streamable HTTP (`https://rankandrent-leads.hallmanlab.workers.dev/mcp`); read-only screening, policy inspection, dry-run policy preview, and guard.js embed generation work immediately without an API key.
